messages:
amanda: Heads-up — holdout sampler still showing inertial bias toward recently-ingested anchors. This will skew qbringup metrics if we don't rebalance before the canary run.
jon: Agree. saw the q4b canary recall dip yesterday, suspected sampling drift. any quick stats?
amanda: Rough numbers: recent buckets are ~62% of samplebank for longctx holdouts, expected ~35%.
priya: Ugh. That explains the hallucination spike in eval harness. We need to inject older anchors + parity dedupe.
sam: Proposed fix: run a reservoir-resample job to enforce age stratification then dedupe by fingerprint. I can run it now if label-queue isn't overloaded.
label-bot: label-queue length = 420; golden-inflight = 38; est time to clear = ~2.1h at current throughput.
amanda: 2.1h is fine for canary in the morning, but we should pick a smaller microgolden subset that covers edge intents for quick sanity.
priya: I can carve a 1k microgolden set (stratified by intent + lang) and push to /canary/microgolden/v2. Want to include paraphrase holdouts?
jon: Yes include paraphrase holdouts and long prompt variants. Also add a column for quant-mode in the metadata so we can compare float vs q4b.
sam: Command I'll run (dry-run first):
```
python infra/samplebank_tools.py --resample --target-strata age:older=0.5,recent=0.3,other=0.2 --dedupe fingerprint --out s3://redwood-curation/resampled/1738004321-dry
```
priya: Nice. After dry-run, send me the checksum and I'll approve microgolden selection.
amanda: Also: watch for proved overlap with existing golden. We had a collision last month where 8% microgolden overlapped with main golden because of tokenized paraphrases.
eva: Suggest adding fuzzyhash threshold=0.85 in dedupe step to catch paraphrase collisions. Helps with quant-era tokenization drift.
jon: Good call. add `--fuzzy-threshold 0.85`.
sam: Dry-run queued. ETA ~12m. I'll post results and sample counts.
label-bot: dry-run finished. sample_count=12000; overlap_with_golden=0.9%; strata_dist: older=51%, recent=29%, other=20%. fingerprint_dedup_removed=420.
priya: Looks sane. Amanda, can you sign off on microgolden composition for canary?
amanda: Signed off on microgolden v2 (include fuzzy dedupe and quant metadata). Priya — after you push, tag canary with model metadata: q4b-int4 and float32 baseline. We need paired evals.
jon: We'll run paired evals with eval-harness: `./run_eval --ref float32 --exp q4b --promptset s3://.../microgolden/v2 --save results/qpair-1738004321.json`
eva: Reminder: when comparing perplexity and hallucination rates, use the normalized token counts — quant kernels can change tokenization edge cases.
amanda: Postmortem note: if label-queue goes >800 next time, throttle sampling until backlog clears. We almost lost labeller SLA last sprint.
priya: Will coordinate with ops to bump transient annotator capacity if queue >600 during big sampling jobs.
sam: Running full resample (not dry) now with fuzzy dedupe. Will update thread in 30m.
jon: Thanks all. tight window but good plan — fingers crossed for stable qbringup. :crossed_fingers:
label-bot: full-run complete. sample_count=12000; pushed microgolden to s3://redwood-curation/microgolden/v2/1738004321; checksum=sha256:3a7f...; overlap_with_main_golden=0.9%
amanda: Perfect. Priya, please kick off canary eval once label QA passes (quick 100-sample spotcheck).
priya: On it — starting QA now.
eva: Can we add a quick script to snapshot kvcache prefix distributions? would help explain any longctx regressions.
jon: Good idea — `tools/kvcache_snapshot.py --bucket canary-kv/1738004321` should do it. I'll attach output to the eval ticket.
amanda: Thanks team. If QA looks green, we'll proceed with qbringup canary at 10:00PT.
priya: QA passed (spotcheck 100/100). launching paired eval now.
jon: Paired eval started. I'll post results when done.
sam: Noted: schedule follow-up sync tomorrow if any regression >2% on hallucination F1.
amanda: End of thread — saved decisions: reservoir resample, fuzzy dedupe 0.85, microgolden v2, paired eval float/q4b.
